customers_say: Customers praise the door lock's quality and features, noting its premium build and appearance, with one mentioning there's no ugly handle sticking out. They appreciate its security features, providing top-tier safety. The installation process receives mixed feedback from customers.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Excellent Product, Delayed Installation
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ The lock looks premium, has great features, and the installation by Prakaash was excellent. He was professional, helpful, and explained everything clearly. The only thing was the installation process. I had to raise a support ticket and follow up manually, and the installation was completed about a week later. Apart from that, everything went smoothly. Overall, a great product with a good first impression.

reviews.author: Deepak S.
reviews.title: Great Lock. Locked Behind Poor Service.
reviews.body: The lock is smart. The installation process... not so much. The lock itself deserves applause. It looks premium, feels sturdy, and performs exactly as you'd expect from a product in this price range. Face unlock is quick, operation is smooth, and the overall build quality is impressive. No complaints about the hardware. Unfortunately, buying a smart lock also means buying the installation experience—and that's where things went downhill.
